card.name: Endings of cephalosporin and drug names
card.fires_on: The final piece of a long drug name just before it ends, such as the 'amil' in ceftaroline fosamil or the 'il' in cefpodoxime proxetil. Mostly cephalosporin antibiotics in label text.

modes.label: Ester or prodrug endings
modes.description: The last piece of a cephalosporin prodrug name such as proxetil, axetil or fosamil.
